question: Which ordinary Chaos Skill packets belong to one admitted public cast, and can their native coefficients be delivered without hiding alternate branches?
stop_condition: Find action/packet membership and description support; implement a bounded tested packet model or leave ambiguous follow-up unsupported and select another supported roster task.
return_condition: New packet reachability, transformed-state or native timing evidence conflicts with the selected model.
checks: 179 content tests pass. Native level1 two bites (.825/2.175) with1000ATK, .5DEF and existing .2Warrant produce495/1305; level8(1.414/3.728) produces848.4/2236.8. A3 skill resonance selects native level9 and existing A2DEF ignore:1.527/4.026 *1000*5/9*1.2=1018/2684.

One admission, same command/target and deterministic first/second delivery are checked. Switching preserves pending off-field ownership. Horizon99us leaves both100us hits pending; target death after the first excludes the second. Failed energy admission schedules neither. Invalid child coordinates, an alternate primary and conflicting assumptions fail; strict requires explicit acceptance of the timing hypothesis.

Existing native Chaos Warrant tests retain independent oracles and now include the second bite: A6 manual primary fixture second bite2.175*1000*5/9*1.4*.9=1522.5; A0 second bite1044. Zero primary damage cannot apply Warrant, while a later nonzero native child can; a dead target stays unmarked.

Public Chaos/GoldWool T1-T5 produces six hits with two Skill packets at.8seconds. Shared modifiers give the independently checked3.728/1.414 child/primary ratio. Full CLI/WASM reports agree; actual Worker T5 agrees. native_build and scenario_script regressions, TypeScript and production build pass; changed Rust format passes; clippy permits only the two existing metadata lints.

The shared CastContext native child helper validates owner/action/target/time and source coefficient scaling/membership, inheriting the already projected talent coordinate. Crime, additional targets, Prime Target progression, transformed chains and full Ultimate packets remain incomplete; flags retain strict_ready=false/game_dps_computed=false.
decision: The saved descriptions specify two bites and list82.5%+217.5%, matching the frozen native Skill1/Skill2 arrays. Admit Skill1 and schedule Skill2 once, on the same target and selected impact timestamp. Coincident timing is a bounded tested hypothesis because animation intervals are unresolved; preserve native E/Lakshana classification and delivery-time buffs. Require the modeled primary packet to prevent direct Skill2 invocations from duplicating the packet train. Both packets use the admitted effective coordinate through shared source projection; no manual child scalar.
